title: FORMIC: a configurable ant-foraging simulator and dynamic interaction-network benchmark
description:
Code for the FORMIC benchmark: a configurable ant-foraging simulator with a unified closest-surface obstacle interface, a 16-scenario suite, per-frame interaction-graph extraction, audit scripts, and trajectory-prediction baselines (persistence, constant velocity, ST-GNN).

The full dataset (1.6 GB of node states and interaction edges) is archived separately on Zenodo.
